title: Verifier Claim Registry - v5
description: Work enforcement-regime claims layered on the v4 consequence registry. These claims report signed historical regime evidence; they do not assert current project configuration or universal correctness of an enforcement implementation.

claims.name: permit.enforcement_regime_at_issuance.v1
claims.assertion: The signed Permit records the server-derived Work enforcement regime, global ceiling, project rung, mapping version, and resolution instant that applied when that Permit was issued.
claims.required_evidence: A supported signed Permit decision or supported Work-chain Permit artifact whose signed resource attributes contain one schema-valid keel.permit_enforcement_state.v1 block with enforcement_surface_key=program:work. The Permit and evidence identities must match, the signed resource-attributes commitment must verify, and the effective-mode tuple must satisfy the pinned rung mapping. Root and child Permits are evaluated independently.
does_not_establish: the enforcement regime at any later dispatch
that an enforcement implementation was correctly implemented
that any specific action was blocked
absence of actions outside the governed boundary

claims.name: permit.enforcement_regime_at_dispatch.v1
claims.assertion: A signed pre-effect runtime proof records the Work enforcement regime, global ceiling, project rung, mapping version, and gate outcome that applied to one exact Permit-bound dispatch attempt.
claims.required_evidence: A supported signed Permit decision or supported Work-chain child Permit, matching exact request and dispatch identities, and a signature-valid keel.runtime_enforcement_proof.v2 with enforcement_surface_key=program:work, pre_effect=true, a schema-valid regime tuple, and internally consistent gate_result, dispatch_attempted, and upstream_called values. A v1 runtime proof or missing runtime proof is historical evidence with the regime not recorded and yields insufficient_evidence for this claim.
does_not_establish: the enforcement regime when the Permit was issued
that an enforcement implementation was correctly implemented
absence of actions outside the governed boundary
